oauth_error_failed: Something went wrong talking to Discord. Try again.
oauth_error_email_unverified: Your Discord email isn’t verified. Verify it in Discord and try again.
oauth_error_email_missing: Discord didn’t share an email address for your account.
oauth_error_already_linked: That Discord account is already linked to another user.
oauth_error_unavailable: Logging in with Discord isn’t available right now.
oauth_link_meta_description: Confirm your password to link Discord to your existing account.
oauth_link_text: An account with the email of your Discord profile already exists. Enter its password to link Discord and log in.
oauth_link_invalid_text: It has expired or was already used. Log in with Discord again to get a new one.
oauth_connections_text: Link Discord to log in faster.
oauth_unlink_text: You will log in with your email and password instead. Enter your password to confirm. If you created your account with Discord, set a password first with “Forgot password”.
